scope: External dependencies declared directly in current workspace package manifests; locally installed metadata and top-level notice filenames where available.
limitations: Does not establish which packages or versions ship in a release.
A package license field and notice filename are not a compatibility or provenance decision.
Current workspace may contain uncommitted changes; source manifest hashes identify this snapshot.
Electron runtime, Chromium notices, bundled native libraries, website images, screenshots and historical source rights require separate review.
